subject: Music Production
title: Sound Waves Explained
description: A fast breakdown of Sound Waves Explained for builders.

hook.text: Every sound you hear is caused by molecules in the air vibrating back and forth rapidly.

buildup.text: These vibrations travel outward in waves, compressing and expanding air as they move.

discovery.text: Sound waves carry energy from a source to your ear without the air molecules actually traveling.

twist.text: In outer space there is no air, which means sound waves cannot travel and space is truly silent.

climax.text: Understanding sound waves is the first step to controlling how music sounds in a production.

punchline.text: Music is just air vibrating in organized patterns.

quiz.question: Why is outer space silent?
options: Sound waves travel too slowly there
There is no air for sound waves to travel through
